text.base:
You've seen enough. Or exactly enough.

EARTH ACCESS GRANTED, NO QUESTIONS ASKED — well.
No further questions asked.

An incomplete form is still a form. The desk does not mind;
the desk has drawers full of first pages, and it keeps
every one.

Go be somebody. Again.

labels: FICTION: the drawer of first pages
nodes.a11y: You return to Earth almost immediately. The Bard grants access without further questions and keeps your first page.
nodes.fallback: You go back, early. The desk keeps your first page.

text.base:
The clerk half-rises, then thinks better of ceremony.

You leave the form where it lies — half-answered, which is,
the Bard notes, how most forms are left, and how most lives
are too, and neither fact has ever stopped the weather.

EARTH ACCESS GRANTED.
Return may include love, weather, taxation, bodies, music,
forgetting, dogs, and unresolved questions.
Yours are packed. Mind the step.

nodes.a11y: You return to Earth mid-way through the paperwork. The form stays half-answered; your unresolved questions are packed for the trip.
nodes.fallback: You leave mid-form. Your questions are packed.

text.base:
So close to the end of the form — and you choose the door
you came in by.

The Bard respects this enormously, and says so, twice,
which for the Bard is an outburst. To walk the whole
corridor and still pick the weather: that is not indecision.
That is testimony.

EARTH ACCESS GRANTED.
Go home the long way. You know the way now.

nodes.a11y: Nearly at the end, you choose to return to Earth. The Bard calls it testimony, not indecision.
nodes.fallback: You walked the whole corridor and chose the weather.

text.base:
You barely give the desk a glance.

You walk toward it. It does not congratulate you.
It does not need to.

The paperwork stays where it is — untouched and, it turns
out, always optional.

Go gently. Mind the brightness.

nodes.a11y: You walk into the light almost immediately, without ceremony. The paperwork was always optional.
nodes.fallback: You walk into the light, early and unbothered.

text.base:
You set the form down mid-question and walk toward it.

The light does not hurry you. It has never hurried anyone;
that is somebody else's department.

The paperwork stays on the desk — incomplete and, it turns
out, always optional.

Go gently.

labels: FICTION: the department of hurrying, unstaffed
nodes.a11y: Mid-way through the questions, you walk into the light. It does not hurry you; the paperwork was always optional.
nodes.fallback: You set the form down and walk into the light.

text.base:
After everything — the cups, the clerks, the cards —
you choose the simple door.

The light receives you without one word about the
paperwork. It was always going to.

Go gently. You already know how.

nodes.a11y: After nearly the whole journey, you choose the light. It receives you without a word about the paperwork.
